subject: info-ds
title: INFO.DS.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 141 (AE(PD)-29). INFO-DS (information dissemination) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: POL-DY (political dynamics) and INFO-DS-2 (information dissemination), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From POL-DY: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From INFO-DS-2: ALT-D (alternative definitions). From LK-IMP: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)). From ALT-D: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From UNF-PI: INFO-INTR (information interpretation). From INFO-INTR: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From ACC-DY: TRS (transition). From TRS: POL-P (political policies).
